recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-11105 unless OO later decides to revisit UDI carrier modeling more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-11105 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Device issue from the DSTU2 ballot asking whether a UDI carrier could be split across multiple barcodes. The accepted resolution said separate DI and PI barcodes may be concatenated with DI first and then in the order of human-readable expression on the label.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in February 2017 Device UDI cleanup commits, especially 05a8652714 and d9163a93a7, which added and preserved the concatenation comment in the UDI carrier spreadsheet rows before later refactors carried it into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml has Device.udiCarrier as 0..* and includes the DI-before-PI concatenation comment on both carrierAIDC and carrierHRF. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion or later contradictory decision, and related Jira FTS returned only FHIR-11105.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative Device source already implements the requested guidance.
